title: Run the v0.2.0 hands-on acceptance checklist
description: NEXT.md 'Try this' items 1-6: install the plugin from the checkout, then remind (toast + 30 s alarm), cancel and stop-while-ringing leave no cli-timer.exe running, ding with no permission prompt, whether Claude reported the reminder fired, and the full-screen timer with and without -s (own mp3/wav/flac/ogg; decoder is now symphonia). CI cannot hear sounds or see pop-ups, so this is manual. If cancel/stop leaves cli-timer.exe running, remind needs to exit when its parent dies (plan Task 9 Step 2).

title: Tag v0.2.0 and publish the release
description: Push the v0.2.0 tag (Cargo.toml is 0.2.0) to trigger release.yml, which verifies the tag, builds Windows/macOS arm64+x86_64/Linux archives and publishes a GitHub release. The manual dry run passed 2026-10-22 (run 39783298970, all four archives). Do it after the hands-on acceptance passes. dotman installs cli-timer from this repo, so the tag reaches that install path too.
